title: Supply Chain Management
description:
Studied the fundamentals of supply chain management, focusing on coordinating materials, information, and logistics activities across supply chain operations.

Key Topics Covered:

Supply Chain Fundamentals: Understanding the relationships between suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and customers.

Procurement and Sourcing: Exploring purchasing activities, supplier selection, and material availability.

Inventory Management: Understanding inventory planning and its role in balancing operational costs and customer requirements.

Logistics and Distribution: Examining transportation, warehousing, and distribution activities.

Supply Chain Coordination: Understanding how information sharing and coordination support operational efficiency.

Supply Chain Performance: Evaluating cost, delivery performance, and resource utilization in supply chain decisions.

Knowledge Gained:

Developed an understanding of how procurement, inventory, transportation, and distribution activities contribute to efficient supply chain operations.

Explored logistics and distribution planning through an academic project involving ABC Logistics and operations across Makkah, Jeddah, and Taif.
